messages:
mira_cs: Heads-up — Acme Health goes live next Wed. We need a one-pager for the customer-facing runbook: prefill/pacing, recommended batching, and streaming fallbacks. Also capture renewal risk signals during first 14 days.

jordan_csm: Thanks — they have a multi-tenant flow with bursty ingress from support channels. Early concern: high short-lived fanout could blow their cost if we don't prefill.

devin_se: @mira_cs can you share their expected QPS and typical prompt lengths? that'll change batching strategy.

mira_cs: Rough numbers from the PO: 40 reqs/min steady, spikes to ~350 reqs/min for 2–3 mins, avg prompt 900 tokens (with system + user). Latency SLO is 500ms p95.

sam_research: For that shape I recommend: 1) small warm pool (2 dedicated instances) during business hours, 2) client-side prefill for known repeated prefixes, 3) server-side prefix KV caching with TTL 30m.

devin_se: +1. Also enable continuous batching on their Dedicated profile with max_batch_size=32 and target_batch_latency_ms=60. That keeps p95 under 500ms for 900 tokens on our quantized models.

alex_pm: Can we document a safe degrade path in the runbook if latency climbs? customer wants graceful fallback not hard errors.

onboard-bot: [runbook-draft] Created: /links/runbooks/acme-onboard-prefill-v1 (editable).

sam_research: Runbook snippet to include (copy into doc):
```yaml
routing:
  primary: dedicated_pool-ACME_DC1
  fallback: hosted-lowcost-2
  degrade_to: cached-responses
prefill:
  client_prefetch: true
  server_kv_ttl_seconds: 1800
  prefetched_prefixes: ["support_thread_meta","welcome_flow_v2"]
batching:
  mode: continuous
  max_batch_size: 32
  target_batch_latency_ms: 60
streaming:
  enabled: true
  fallback_interval_ms: 3000 # poll if stream stalls
```

devin_se: Also include these telemetry events to capture renewal signals: first_successful_live_session, sustained_error_rate_1h, avg_response_tokens_14d, tail_latency_p95_14d. Tie thresholds to automated renewal-risk flag.

jordan_csm: Suggest adding a lightweight NPS/CSAT ping after the 3rd successful convo + an in-app short feedback widget. We'll capture early quality signals. Link to widget: https://docs.internal/feedback-widget

mira_cs: Renewal-risk thresholds: flag when sustained_error_rate_1h > 2% OR tail_latency_p95_14d > 1s OR active_users_week < expected_week * 0.6 (expectation from PO). Add auto-escalation to CSM if flagged.

alex_pm: Who owns rollout steps and runbook customer-send? @jordan_csm you + @devin_se for config verification, @mira_cs to approve wording. I'll schedule a 30m handoff on Tue.

jordan_csm: I'll draft the email + onboarding checklist. Plan: 1) prefill keys and tokens, 2) enable KV cache + batching, 3) run loadtest with spike sim, 4) enable streaming + poll fallback, 5) enable telemetry hooks, 6) go-live.

devin_se: For the spike sim, use this simple k6 snippet (attach to runbook):
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  for (let i=0;i<10;i++) http.post(__ENV.ENDPOINT, JSON.stringify({prompt: 'prefill test'}), {headers:{'Authorization':__ENV.TOKEN}});
  sleep(0.2);
}
```

sam_research: One more ops tip: set optimistic cache warmup on their first 1000 expected sessions so cached prefixes populate before spike windows. Mark in runbook as optional.

mira_cs: Great — final ask: add a one-question feedback capture after the first 2 weeks for renewal-risk contextual data: "Did system meet your SLAs for response quality and speed? (y/n) — optional comment." We'll wire into CS dashboard.

onboard-bot: [runbook-updated] /links/runbooks/acme-onboard-prefill-v1 -> v1.1 by jordan_csm

jordan_csm: I'll finish the one-pager tonight and ping you all when it's ready for review. If anyone has short bullets to add (esp. exact prefetched prefixes or telemetry names) drop them here. :rocket:
